job.title: Design System Engineer (UI/UX + Frontend)
job.description: Stratosphere Finance is a Mumbai-based fintech scale-up powering neo-banking for SMEs. We are seeking a Design System Engineer who sits at the intersection of design and code. You will own and evolve our shared Figma component library and its React/TypeScript implementation in Storybook. This role requires Figma proficiency, React component authoring, accessibility (WCAG 2.1), and clear documentation skills. Experience with token-based theming systems is a strong advantage.

pool.text: Figma: built multi-brand design system with 80+ components, auto-layout, variants, and component properties; maintained token definitions using Tokens Studio plugin
React + TypeScript: authored 20 reusable UI components (Button, Input, Modal, DataTable) with prop-based API and forwardRef support
Storybook: documented all design system components with args tables, controls, and accessibility addon checks; deployed to Chromatic for visual regression
CSS custom properties and design tokens: implemented light/dark theme switching and 3 brand themes via CSS variable overrides derived from Tokens Studio export
WCAG 2.1 AA: audited every component with axe-core and VoiceOver; wrote ARIA patterns for combobox, dialog, and accordion
Frontend Design Intern at Clearpath Lending (Pune, 6 months): migrated 15 legacy jQuery components to a new React design system, reduced CSS bundle by 28%
OpenLoom UI: open-source React component library — 30+ components, Storybook, design tokens, theme provider; 180 GitHub stars
B.Tech Information Technology, COEP Pune, 2022–2026, CGPA 8.6/10
Jest + Testing Library: wrote 95% coverage unit tests for all design system components
Terraform: wrote IaC modules for provisioning S3 and CloudFront for Storybook static deployment
Technical writing: authored component usage guidelines, migration guides, and changelog entries for design system consumers
Figma component API design: defined slot patterns and composition strategies for complex components like DataTable and FormField
COBOL: studied legacy mainframe COBOL during a banking-domain module; not used in production
